instruction: For Tesla calendar 2024, report Q1 R&D as q1_rd in usd_million and Q2 sequential R&D change as sequential_change in percent. Use the supplied filing. Set conclusion to null.
context:
# Filing extract
Tesla, Inc. Form 10-Q, quarter ended June 30, 2024, filed July 24, 2024. Dollars in millions. Three-month and six-month columns each have separate 2024 and 2023 comparisons. Q2 means three months ended June 30. H1 means six months ended June 30. The expenses table preserves these column labels. R&D is a period expense.

Source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1318605/000162828024032662/tsla-20240630.htm

answers.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN amount_million END) q2, MAX(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN amount_million END) h1 FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND year=2024 AND metric='R&D') SELECT h1-q2 AS value FROM p

WITH p AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN period='Q2' THEN amount_million END) q2, MAX(CASE WHEN period='H1' THEN amount_million END) h1 FROM expenses WHERE entity='Tesla' AND year=2024 AND metric='R&D') SELECT 100.0*(q2-(h1-q2))/(h1-q2) AS value FROM p
